title: Total Wake Time
formula: total wake time = initial sleep latency + WASO
lesson: Total recorded wake time includes wake before sleep onset plus wake after sleep onset through lights on. It equals TRT − TST, or initial sleep latency + WASO, when all values cover the same recording interval.
memoryClue: Total wake combines the wake before sleep and the wake after sleep begins.
coachBobNote: If the problem asks for WASO only, do not include initial sleep latency. If it asks for total wake, include both.
